clips.title: The story
paras: To secure a cask of Evershine for Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot, an adventurer must first lend a hand to Brewnall Village. Brewer Rejold Barleybrew refuses to part with his liquor until the dangerous predators roaming the nearby snowdrifts are thinned out.

Rejold Barleybrew has the cask of Evershine that Pilot Bellowfiz requires, but he is in no hurry to surrender his prized brew for free. Rather than asking for coin, Rejold asks for protection. The wild beasts of western Dun Morogh—ravenous Ice Claw Bears, thick-hided Elder Crag Boars, and prowling Snow Leopards—wander uncomfortably close to Brewnall Village, creating constant distraction and peril for the locals.

While Rejold is quick to insist that no self-respecting dwarf cowers before wild animals, dealing with predators around the clock consumes valuable hours. Culling the local wildlife gives the villagers the peace they need to focus on distillation and smithing without keeping one eye perpetually on the tree line.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor? Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows. Sometimes they wander close.
We're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting traveler would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you taken care of those wild animals?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
